# ztna_connector_quiesce (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage the quiesce state of a ZTNA Connector.
resource "ztna_connector_quiesce" "example" {
  oid  = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
  mode = "<mode>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String)
- `oid` (String) Parent connector OID. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `tfid` (String)


## Import

The following command can be used to import a resource not managed by Terraform:

```bash
terraform import ztna_connector_quiesce.example :::oid
```
